evidence: Every user-facing length validation on reality-server public write paths measures BYTES (str::len()) but the constants and 400 error messages are phrased in CHARACTERS. Slovak/Czech/German text is diacritic-heavy (2 bytes per char); ~2500 accented chars already exceeds a 5000-'character' cap, roughly halving the effective allowance for sk/cs/de.

Six call sites: inquiries.rs:43-55 validate_inquiry_lengths (name/email/phone/message), inquiries.rs:425-464 request_viewing (same + preferred-time), inquiries.rs:786-789 respond_to_inquiry (magic 5000 rather than MAX_INQUIRY_MESSAGE_LEN), articles.rs:456-461 create_comment (MAX_COMMENT_BODY_LEN 5000), agent_reviews.rs:212-215 create_review (MAX_REVIEW_BODY_LEN 5000), reports.rs submit_report (MAX_REPORT_DESCRIPTION_LEN 5000).

Fix: replace .len() with .chars().count() on the free-text fields; route respond_to_inquiry through MAX_INQUIRY_MESSAGE_LEN; keep byte caps as a separate hard-DoS backstop but worded as bytes. IG3: unit test asserting N-accented-char string at N <= limit is accepted.

reality-server submit_report (routes/reports.rs, POST /api/v1/reports, UC-23) is OptionalRequestPrincipal / anonymous-allowed. reporter_email and reporter_phone (SubmitReportRequest, reports.rs:91-92) bound straight into INSERT (reports.rs:279-280) with NO length or format validation.

Sibling inquiries path caps email at MAX_INQUIRY_EMAIL_LEN (320) and phone at MAX_INQUIRY_PHONE_LEN (32) and runs InquiriesHandler::validate_contact. The report path shares the inquiry rate limiter so raw request VOLUME is throttled, but a single permitted request can persist an arbitrarily large / malformed string.

Impact: row bloat in listing_reports.reporter_email/reporter_phone, junk contact data surfaced to moderators, and (if the DB column has a length constraint) a raw DB error → generic 500 via db_error() instead of a clean 400.
Fix: before INSERT apply the existing inquiry caps/validators (MAX_INQUIRY_EMAIL_LEN, MAX_INQUIRY_PHONE_LEN, validate_contact) and return 400 with a generic message.
